item.title: HIGHLIGHTS: Kewaunee remains unbeaten, taking down Bonduel in a thriller
item.description: KEWAUNEE, Wis. (WFRV) -- Despite leading by as many as 10 points, Bonduel couldn't pick up a road win over unbeaten Kewaunee. The Storm taking down the Bears 81-77, with Connor Kilgore leading the team in scoring with 19 points. Bonduel, after starting the season 12-0, has now lost three of its last five games.
